original_law.definition: Original GaussianLaw = infinitePi of gaussianReal0,1 on the exact natural-index stream.
original_law.transport: Injective coordinate selections give actual product laws; dependent curry/group and finitePi rearrangements prove the three actual disjoint blocks have a joint law and iIndepFun.

Laplace_and_Chernoff.scalar: Integral exp(t Z^2)=(sqrt(1-2t))^-1 for t<1/2, including negative t; positive nonzero evaluated integral proves integrability.
Laplace_and_Chernoff.weighted: Actual finite independent coordinate product yields the weighted quadratic transform on each exact finite integrability domain.
Laplace_and_Chernoff.lower: For nonnegative weights split by actual positive cutoff a, choose theta=eta/(2a); head log cost and tail log inequality cancel the threshold term and yield exp(-q*r*eta/4). The a=0 strict bad event is proved empty.
Laplace_and_Chernoff.upper: Normalize by positive total weight, use logarithm concavity and log(1+eta)<=eta-eta^2/4 on0<=eta<=1; choose theta=eta/(2(1+eta)). Total weight0 is separate, avoiding division by zero.
Laplace_and_Chernoff.unscaled_factors: Thresholds are q*(1-eta)*tail_energy and q*(1+eta)*total_energy because actual G entries have variance1, not1/q.

actual_rotation_and_residual.law: Pi scalar law maps through WithLp2 to actual Euclidean stdGaussian, fixed real linear isometries preserve that law, and maps back/flattening give the actual full rotated coordinate law.
actual_rotation_and_residual.SVD: Fixed B uses actual exactSVD(B) factors, via unconditional svd_total. U and V Gram/cogram identities come from literal valid SVD; no B-full-rank premise.
actual_rotation_and_residual.energy: Pointwise squaredFrobenius(B*G,0)=sum(i,j) sigma_i(B)^2*(V(B)^T G)_ij^2, including zero singular values and empty dimensions.
actual_rotation_and_residual.spectrum: Actual chosen sigma is nonnegative and antitone; actual head consists of i<r, card=r when r<=n. Cutoff sigma_r^2 separates the sorted head and tail and may equal0. Sum sigma_i^2 equals literal squaredFrobenius(B,0).
actual_rotation_and_residual.measurability_boundary: B is fixed for each tail theorem. No global SVD-selector measurability or random-B rotation law is assumed.

actual_warm_selection.method: Each fixed residual A-F(b) gets its actual-law tail bound; finite union over all m+2 candidates plus one fixed optimal upper event and actual minimumIndex_score_le control the random selected residual.
actual_warm_selection.chosen_index: Actual finite scan of the original unscaled G0 scores; equality to sketchWarmIndex(makePlan) is proved under the literal sketch branch.
actual_warm_selection.OPT: Original attained optimum squared equals the actual minimal residual squared energy; zero OPT requires no extra assumption.
actual_warm_selection.law: Every bad-event bound is under original GaussianLaw; conditional generic HasLaw lemmas are discharged by the actual fixed-residual law in the final concrete theorem.
